name: Throg
description:
Small frog, mighty hammer: the Frog of Thunder.
Puddlegulper was a frog until he found a sliver of Mjolnir. Now he is Throg, the Frog of Thunder, hurling Frogjolnir and calling down Frogbolts. Between Two Worlds pulls him back to the pond, and Thanos comes looking for the Power Stone. Includes a Justice starter deck. 22 cards. Spanish original, English translation. Pairs with The Mad Titan's Shadow.
